metaTitle: Custom Full Color Blankets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color blankets for your brand. Vibrant, all-over printing for events, gifts, and promotions. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Full color blankets let you print logos, photos, or intricate designs across the entire fabric — no color limits, no fade worries. Whether you're creating a staff gift with a team photo or a promotional blanket for a trade show giveaway, the Roll-Up Fleece Blanket and Foto Vision™ Plush Throw offer sharp, vibrant results. Dye sublimation ensures your artwork stays bright wash after wash, making these blankets a lasting reminder of your brand.
heroAltText: Custom full color blankets with vibrant all-over print design, perfect for promotional gifts and corporate events.
